nodes.name: Preparar respuesta de éxito para Vapi

parameters.content:
## AI Voice Appointment 

Booking & CRM Automation

Production-style booking workflow for a Spanish-speaking AI voice assistant.

The system collects lead information through Vapi, validates the booking request, checks live calendar availability, creates a Google Meet appointment, registers the lead in a CRM and sends a branded confirmation email.

Core integrations:
• Vapi + ElevenLabs
• n8n
• Google Calendar
• Google Sheets CRM
• Gmail

The workflow is modular and can be adapted to different voice platforms, calendars, CRM systems, forms and email providers.

## 2. Invalid Request Handling

Invalid or incomplete booking requests are prevented from reaching Google Calendar.

The workflow returns a structured response containing the exact validation reasons. The voice assistant can then request only the information that needs to be corrected.

No calendar event, CRM record or confirmation email is created on this branch.

## 1. Voice Request Intake & Validation

The workflow receives a structured reservar_cita tool call from the Vapi voice assistant.

Client name, email, business, requested service, project objective, date and time are normalized and validated before any external action is performed.

The validation layer checks required fields, email format, date format, business rules, weekends and timezone consistency.

## 3. Real-Time Availability Recheck

Availability is checked again immediately before creating the appointment.

Even if the slot was available when it was first offered by consultar_disponibilidad, another person may have booked it before the user confirmed.

This second check prevents outdated availability from creating conflicting appointments.

## 4. Final Availability Recheck

If the selected time has become unavailable, the booking process stops safely.

No event is created and the assistant receives a slot_unavailable response. It can then explain the situation naturally and call consultar_disponibilidad again to offer updated alternatives.

This reduces stale-slot booking risk. Strict concurrency guarantees require a lock or transactional reservation mechanism.

## 5. Calendar & Google Meet Creation

Once the booking is validated and the slot is confirmed as available, the workflow creates a 30-minute Google Calendar event.

The client is added as an attendee, a Google Meet link is generated and the event stores the lead details, requested service, project objective and Vapi identifiers.

All appointment times are handled using the Europe/Madrid timezone.

## 6. Low-Latency Voice Response

After the calendar event is confirmed, a structured success response is returned to Vapi immediately.

This allows the voice assistant to confirm the appointment without waiting for secondary operations such as CRM registration or email delivery.

The remaining automation continues after the voice response has been sent.

## 7. CRM Registration & Idempotency

The confirmed appointment is registered in a lightweight Google Sheets CRM.

Each record contains the client details, service, meeting time, Calendar event ID, Google Meet link, Vapi identifiers and operational statuses.

A unique booking key based on email, date and time is used to update existing records instead of creating accidental duplicates.

## 8. Confirmation Email & Status Tracking

The client receives a branded HTML confirmation email containing the appointment details and direct access to Google Meet.

After successful delivery, the same CRM record is updated from PENDING to SENT, including the delivery timestamp and last update time.

Because the communication layer is separated from the booking logic, Gmail can be replaced with another email or notification provider without redesigning the complete workflow.
